def rat_in_maze(maze):
    n = len(maze)
    path, visited = [], set()
    def backtrack(r, c):
        if r == n - 1 and c == n - 1:
            path.append((r, c))
            return True
        if 0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < n and maze[r][c] == 1 and (r, c) not in visited:
            visited.add((r, c))
            path.append((r, c))
            for dr, dc in [(1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (0, -1)]:
                if backtrack(r + dr, c + dc):
                    return True
            path.pop()
        return False
    return path if backtrack(0, 0) else None

maze = [[1, 0, 0, 0],
        [1, 1, 0, 1],
        [0, 1, 0, 0],
        [1, 1, 1, 1]]
print(rat_in_maze(maze))
